Football Players Suffer Hamstring Injuries

San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Deebo Samuel sustained a hamstring injury during a game against the Seattle Seahawks. Separately, Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams missed his third consecutive game due to a hamstring injury.
